blocks.zh: 產品檢驗與結果判讀
blocks.en: Product Testing and Interpretation of Results

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握產品測試的標準取樣量（10 g/10 mL）及特殊情況下的減量規則
blocks.en: Master the standard sample quantity for product testing (10 g/10 mL) and the rules for reducing it in special cases

blocks.zh: 理解三種方法在實際產品測試中的具體操作流程和培養條件
blocks.en: Understand the specific procedures and incubation conditions of the three methods in actual product testing

blocks.zh: 正確解讀 TAMC 和 TYMC 的定義及其與培養基的對應關係
blocks.en: Correctly interpret the definitions of TAMC and TYMC and how they relate to the culture media

blocks.zh: 掌握微生物限度標準的「半對數」（half-log）判讀規則
blocks.en: Master the "half-log" interpretation rule for microbial limit criteria

blocks.zh: 將 USP 〈61〉 與 USP 〈62〉（特定微生物試驗）的關係連結起來
blocks.en: Link USP <61> to USP <62> (Tests for Specified Microorganisms)

blocks.zh: 2.1 Amount Used for the Test — 測試取樣量
blocks.en: 2.1 Amount Used for the Test

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 品酒師的品評量：
blocks.en: The wine taster's sample volume:

blocks.zh: 取樣量就像品酒師品評一桶酒需要的量。一般的大桶酒，你需要取足夠的量（10 mL）來做全面分析。但如果是一瓶極珍貴的年份酒（極小批量），你不可能倒掉一半來做測試 — 所以 USP 允許只取批量的 1%。如果是臨床試驗的少量樣品（就像限量版的珍藏酒），你只能取 1–2 單位。
blocks.en: The sample quantity is like the amount a wine taster needs to evaluate a barrel of wine. For an ordinary large barrel, you take enough (10 mL) for a full analysis. But for a bottle of rare vintage wine (a very small batch), you can't pour out half of it for testing, so USP allows you to use only 1% of the batch. For a small clinical trial sample (like a limited-edition collector's wine), you can only take 1-2 units.

blocks.zh: 核心原則是：取樣量必須足以代表產品品質，同時也要考慮產品的可取得性。
blocks.en: The core principle is: the sample quantity must be sufficient to represent product quality, while also taking into account how much product is available.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務中的常見場景：
blocks.en: Common scenarios in CDMO practice:

blocks.zh: 原料入庫：大桶裝的賦形劑（如 20 kg 乳糖）— 直接取 10 g 無壓力
blocks.en: Raw material receipt: For bulk excipients (such as 20 kg of lactose), taking 10 g is no problem

blocks.zh: 高效價 API：某些生物製劑原料每劑量可能只含 µg 級 — 需要按「10 劑量單位」規則計算取樣量
blocks.en: High-potency API: Some biologic materials may contain only µg quantities per dosage unit, so the sample quantity must be calculated under the "10 dosage units" rule

blocks.zh: 臨床試驗批次：Phase I 試驗可能只製造 50–100 支注射劑 — 此時可降至 1–2 單位
blocks.en: Clinical trial batches: A Phase I study may produce only 50-100 injection vials, in which case the quantity can be reduced to 1-2 units

blocks.zh: 「隨機取樣」的要求：最後一段強調必須隨機取樣（at random）。在實務中，這意味著不能只從批次的「最方便」位置取樣 — 要確保樣品具有代表性。
blocks.en: The "random sampling" requirement: The final sentence stresses that sampling must be done at random. In practice, this means you cannot sample only from the "most convenient" locations in the batch; you must make sure the samples are representative.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Industry Application
blocks.en: Industry Application

blocks.zh: 取樣量對放行檢驗的影響：在 CDMO 的商業製造中，10 g 或 10 mL 的取樣量通常不是問題。但要注意：
blocks.en: Impact of sample quantity on release testing: In commercial CDMO manufacturing, a 10 g or 10 mL sample is usually not a problem. However, note the following:

blocks.zh: 微生物測試的取樣量（10 g）與化學測試的取樣量是分開的
blocks.en: The sample quantity for microbial testing (10 g) is separate from the quantity for chemical testing

blocks.zh: 需要在批次紀錄中記錄實際取樣量並保存留樣
blocks.en: The actual sample quantity must be recorded in the batch record and retention samples must be kept

blocks.zh: 對於多產品共用設備的 CDMO，每次換產品都需要重新評估取樣策略
blocks.en: For a CDMO with multi-product shared equipment, the sampling strategy must be re-evaluated at every product changeover

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 收到一批 500 g 的高效價 API（每劑量含量 0.5 mg）。根據 USP 〈61〉 的規則，你應該取多少樣品進行測試？
blocks.en: Your CDMO receives a 500 g lot of high-potency API (0.5 mg per dosage unit). Under the rules of USP <61>, how much sample should you test?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 要求「mix the contents of a sufficient number of containers」？如果只從一個容器取樣，可能會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does USP require you to "mix the contents of a sufficient number of containers"? What problems could arise if you sampled from only one container?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Examination of the Product — 產品檢驗
blocks.en: 2.2 Examination of the Product

blocks.zh: 「雙城記」— 兩個溫度，兩個世界：
blocks.en: "A Tale of Two Cities": two temperatures, two worlds:

blocks.zh: TAMC 和 TYMC 就像住在兩個不同氣候區的居民：
blocks.en: TAMC and TYMC are like residents of two different climate zones:

blocks.zh: TAMC（30–35°C）= 住在溫暖城市的居民（細菌為主）— 在「TSA 大廈」裡生活 3–5 天就能看到
blocks.en: TAMC (30-35°C) = residents of the warm city (mainly bacteria), who thrive in the "TSA tower" and are visible in 3-5 days

blocks.zh: TYMC（20–25°C）= 住在涼爽城市的居民（黴菌/酵母菌為主）— 在「SDA 公寓」裡需要 5–7 天才長得好
blocks.en: TYMC (20-25°C) = residents of the cool city (mainly molds/yeasts), who need 5-7 days to grow well in the "SDA apartments"

blocks.zh: 黴菌酵母菌生長較慢，所以需要較低溫度和較長時間。
blocks.en: Molds and yeasts grow more slowly, so they need a lower temperature and a longer incubation time.

blocks.zh: 平板計數法的菌落數上限：選擇計數的稀釋度時，TAMC 選菌落數最多但 <250 的平板，TYMC 選菌落數最多但 <50 的平板。這些上限是為了確保計數的準確性 — 菌落太多會重疊，計數就不精確了。
blocks.en: Colony count limits for the plate-count method: When choosing the dilution to count, for TAMC select the plate with the highest number of colonies less than 250, and for TYMC the plate with the highest number of colonies less than 50. These limits ensure counting accuracy, because too many colonies overlap and make counting imprecise.

blocks.zh: TAMC <250 vs TYMC <50：為什麼差這麼多？因為黴菌菌落比細菌大得多（一個黴菌菌落可以蔓延整個平板），50 個黴菌菌落在平板上已經非常擁擠了。
blocks.en: TAMC <250 vs TYMC <50: Why such a big difference? Because mold colonies are much larger than bacterial colonies (a single mold colony can spread across an entire plate), so 50 mold colonies on a plate is already very crowded.

blocks.zh: MPN 法的培養時間：注意實際產品測試的 MPN 培養時間是 3–5 天（比方法適用性驗證的 ≤3 天略長），這是為了確保在產品存在的可能抑制條件下，微生物仍有足夠時間生長。
blocks.en: Incubation time for the MPN method: Note that the MPN incubation time for actual product testing is 3-5 days (slightly longer than the 3 days or less used in method suitability), to ensure that microorganisms still have enough time to grow under the inhibitory conditions the product may present.

blocks.zh: 如果你用傾注法測 TAMC，做了三個稀釋度（1:10, 1:100, 1:1000），每個稀釋度兩個平板，結果如下：1:10 → (280, 295)、1:100 → (32, 28)、1:1000 → (3, 5)。你應該用哪個稀釋度的結果來報告？TAMC 是多少 cfu/g？
blocks.en: If you use the pour-plate method for TAMC with three dilutions (1:10, 1:100, 1:1000), two plates per dilution, and the results are: 1:10 → (280, 295), 1:100 → (32, 28), 1:1000 → (3, 5). Which dilution should you use for reporting? What is the TAMC in cfu/g?

blocks.zh: 薄膜過濾法用兩片濾膜，但平板計數法要求至少兩個平板。為什麼薄膜過濾法不需要做「重複」？
blocks.en: Membrane filtration uses two filters, yet the plate-count method requires at least two plates. Why does membrane filtration not need "replicates"?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 實際產品檢驗的培養條件總整理
blocks.en: Core Concept: Summary of Incubation Conditions for Actual Product Testing

blocks.zh: 兩片濾膜：薄膜過濾法在實際產品測試時需要兩片濾膜 — 一片放 SCDA（測 TAMC），另一片放 SDA（測 TYMC）。這與方法適用性驗證時每菌一片的做法不同。
blocks.en: Two membrane filters: In actual product testing, membrane filtration requires two filters: one placed on SCDA (for TAMC) and the other on SDA (for TYMC). This differs from method suitability, where one filter is used per organism.

blocks.zh: 2.3 Interpretation of the Results — 結果判讀
blocks.en: 2.3 Interpretation of the Results

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 TAMC 與 TYMC 的定義
blocks.en: Core Concept: Definitions of TAMC and TYMC

blocks.zh: 關鍵定義（經常被誤解）：
blocks.en: Key definitions (often misunderstood):

blocks.zh: TAMC = SCDA 上的所有 cfu — 包括在 SCDA 上長出的黴菌/酵母菌。「Total Aerobic Microbial Count」涵蓋所有在此條件下生長的微生物，不僅是細菌。
blocks.en: TAMC = all cfu on SCDA, including molds/yeasts that grow on SCDA. "Total Aerobic Microbial Count" covers all microorganisms that grow under these conditions, not just bacteria.

blocks.zh: TYMC = SDA 上的所有 cfu — 同樣地，如果細菌在 SDA 上也能生長，它們也被計入 TYMC。
blocks.en: TYMC = all cfu on SDA; likewise, if bacteria also grow on SDA, they are counted in the TYMC.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：TAMC 和 TYMC 不是互斥的分類。某些微生物可能同時出現在兩種培養基上。因此，TAMC + TYMC 不等於「總微生物數」。
blocks.en: This means: TAMC and TYMC are not mutually exclusive categories. Some microorganisms may appear on both media. Therefore, TAMC + TYMC does not equal the "total microbial count".

blocks.zh: 計算說明 接受標準的「半對數」判讀規則
blocks.en: Calculation Note: The "Half-Log" Interpretation Rule for Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: USP 的接受標準使用 0.5 log 的容差：
blocks.en: The USP acceptance criteria use a 0.5 log tolerance:

blocks.zh:
規格表示    實際上限    計算邏輯
10^1 cfu    20 cfu     10^1.3 ≈ 20（四捨五入）
10^2 cfu    200 cfu    10^2.3 ≈ 200
10^3 cfu    2000 cfu   10^3.3 ≈ 2000

通用公式：
  規格 = 10^n cfu
  最大可接受計數 = 2 × 10^n
blocks.en:
Specification    Actual limit    Calculation logic
10^1 cfu        20 cfu          10^1.3 ≈ 20 (rounded)
10^2 cfu        200 cfu         10^2.3 ≈ 200
10^3 cfu        2000 cfu        10^3.3 ≈ 2000

General formula:
  Specification = 10^n cfu
  Maximum acceptable count = 2 × 10^n

blocks.zh: 這意味著 10<sup>2</sup> cfu 的規格實際上允許最多 200 cfu — 這是一個相當大的「緩衝區」，反映了微生物計數方法固有的變異性。
blocks.en: This means a specification of 10<sup>2</sup> cfu actually allows up to 200 cfu. This is a fairly large "buffer", reflecting the inherent variability of microbial enumeration methods.

blocks.zh: 速限與超速罰單：
blocks.en: Speed limits and speeding tickets:

blocks.zh: 微生物限度標準就像道路的速限：
blocks.en: Microbial limit criteria are like road speed limits:

blocks.zh: 速限牌寫 10<sup>2</sup> cfu（相當於時速 100 km/h）
blocks.en: The sign says 10<sup>2</sup> cfu (equivalent to 100 km/h)

blocks.zh: 但你實際上要到 200 cfu 才算「超速」（就像某些地方時速 120 km/h 以上才開罰）
blocks.en: But you are not actually "speeding" until 200 cfu (like places where you are only ticketed above 120 km/h)

blocks.zh: 這個「緩衝區」不是因為法規寬鬆，而是因為微生物計數本身有自然變異 — 同一個樣品測兩次，結果可能差 30-50%
blocks.en: This "buffer" is not there because the regulation is lax, but because microbial counts vary naturally: testing the same sample twice can give results that differ by 30-50%

blocks.zh: 所以 USP 給了大約 0.3 log 的容差（log 20 = 1.3，比規格的 1 多了 0.3 log），這在微生物學上是合理的。
blocks.en: So USP allows a tolerance of roughly 0.3 log (log 20 = 1.3, which is 0.3 log above the specification's 1), which is reasonable in microbiology.

blocks.zh: 含抗生素的 SDA：當細菌在 SDA 上大量生長，導致 TYMC 結果不準確時（因為你分不清哪些是黴菌哪些是細菌），可以使用含有抗生素（通常是 chloramphenicol 或 chlortetracycline）的 SDA 來抑制細菌生長，只讓黴菌/酵母菌生長。
blocks.en: SDA with antibiotics: When bacteria grow heavily on SDA and make the TYMC result inaccurate (because you cannot tell which colonies are molds and which are bacteria), you can use SDA containing an antibiotic (usually chloramphenicol or chlortetracycline) to suppress bacterial growth so that only molds/yeasts grow.

blocks.zh: USP 〈61〉 與 〈62〉 的分工：
blocks.en: Division of labor between USP <61> and <62>:

blocks.zh: 〈61〉 = 「數量」問題 — 有多少微生物？（TAMC、TYMC）
blocks.en: <61> = the "how many" question: how many microorganisms are there? (TAMC, TYMC)

blocks.zh: 〈62〉 = 「種類」問題 — 有沒有特定的致病菌？（如 E. coli、Salmonella、P. aeruginosa、S. aureus）
blocks.en: <62> = the "which kinds" question: are specific pathogens present? (such as E. coli, Salmonella, P. aeruginosa, S. aureus)

blocks.zh: 兩者通常搭配使用。一個產品可能 TAMC/TYMC 合格（數量 OK），但仍因檢出特定致病菌而不合格。
blocks.en: The two are usually used together. A product may pass TAMC/TYMC (the numbers are fine) and still fail because a specified pathogen is detected.

blocks.zh: 結果判讀的商業影響：
blocks.en: Business impact of result interpretation:

blocks.zh: 原料放行：如果入庫的賦形劑 TAMC 結果為 150 cfu/g，接受標準為 102 cfu/g（最大 200）— 合格。但如果是 220 cfu/g — 不合格，需退貨或偏差處理。
blocks.en: Raw material release: If an incoming excipient has a TAMC of 150 cfu/g against an acceptance criterion of 102 cfu/g (maximum 200), it passes. But at 220 cfu/g it fails and must be rejected or handled through a deviation.

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析：即使結果合格，持續接近上限的趨勢需要被追蹤和調查。例如連續三批的 TAMC 都在 150–180 cfu/g 範圍，雖然每批都合格，但趨勢令人擔憂。
blocks.en: Trend analysis: Even when results pass, a trend that stays close to the limit must be tracked and investigated. For example, if three consecutive batches all have TAMC in the 150-180 cfu/g range, each batch passes but the trend is concerning.

blocks.zh: 數據完整性：結果報告必須包含：方法、稀釋度、計數值、計算過程、最終 cfu/g 或 cfu/mL 結果。
blocks.en: Data integrity: The reported result must include the method, dilution, count values, calculation, and the final cfu/g or cfu/mL result.

blocks.zh: 一批口服液的微生物限度標準為 TAMC ≤ 10<sup>3</sup> cfu/mL 且 TYMC ≤ 10<sup>2</sup> cfu/mL。測試結果：TAMC = 1800 cfu/mL，TYMC = 180 cfu/mL。這批產品合格嗎？說明你的判斷邏輯。
blocks.en: The microbial limits for a batch of oral liquid are TAMC ≤ 10<sup>3</sup> cfu/mL and TYMC ≤ 10<sup>2</sup> cfu/mL. The test results are TAMC = 1800 cfu/mL and TYMC = 180 cfu/mL. Does the batch pass? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 如果 SCDA（TSA）上長出了明顯的黴菌菌落，這些菌落應該計入 TAMC 嗎？為什麼 USP 要這樣規定？
blocks.en: If obvious mold colonies grow on SCDA (TSA), should they be counted in the TAMC? Why does USP specify it this way?

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 客戶的產品 TAMC 結果為 195 cfu/g（規格 10<sup>2</sup> cfu/g，最大可接受 200）。雖然技術上合格，作為 QA 經理你會怎麼處理？
blocks.en: A CDMO client's product has a TAMC result of 195 cfu/g (specification 10<sup>2</sup> cfu/g, maximum acceptable 200). Although it technically passes, how would you handle it as the QA manager?

blocks.zh: 2.4 Connection to USP 〈62〉 — 與 USP 〈62〉 的關聯
blocks.en: 2.4 Connection to USP <62>

blocks.zh: 健康檢查的「兩關」：
blocks.en: The two "checkpoints" of a health check:

blocks.zh: 〈61〉 就像量血壓 — 告訴你「數字」（血壓值，類比微生物計數）。〈62〉 就像驗血 — 告訴你血液中有沒有「特定的問題」（如某種病毒抗體，類比特定致病菌）。兩者都需要做，才能得到完整的健康圖像。產品可能「血壓正常」（TAMC/TYMC 合格）但「血液中有病毒」（檢出致病菌），仍然不合格。
blocks.en: <61> is like measuring blood pressure: it gives you a "number" (the blood pressure reading, analogous to a microbial count). <62> is like a blood test: it tells you whether there is a "specific problem" in the blood (such as an antibody to a particular virus, analogous to a specified pathogen). You need both to get the full health picture. A product may have "normal blood pressure" (TAMC/TYMC pass) but "a virus in the blood" (a pathogen is detected) and still fail.

blocks.zh: 培養基和試劑規格：雖然 〈61〉 在正文中提到了 SCDA、SDA、SCDB 等培養基，但這些培養基的詳細成分和配製方法是在 〈62〉 和 USP 通用試劑章節中描述的。實驗室在配製培養基時需要參照這些規格。
blocks.en: Media and reagent specifications: Although <61> mentions media such as SCDA, SDA, and SCDB in its main text, the detailed composition and preparation of these media are described in <62> and in the USP general reagents chapters. Laboratories must refer to these specifications when preparing media.

blocks.zh: 一批原料的 TAMC = 50 cfu/g（規格 102 cfu/g），TYMC = 10 cfu/g（規格 101 cfu/g），但 〈62〉 測試檢出 E. coli（規格：不得檢出/g）。這批原料的微生物品質判定結果是什麼？
blocks.en: A raw material has TAMC = 50 cfu/g (specification 102 cfu/g) and TYMC = 10 cfu/g (specification 101 cfu/g), but the <62> test detects E. coli (specification: absence in 1 g). What is the microbial quality disposition of this material?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 把微生物計數（〈61〉）和特定微生物試驗（〈62〉）分成兩個獨立的章節，而不是合併成一個？
blocks.en: Why does USP separate microbial enumeration (<61>) and tests for specified microorganisms (<62>) into two independent chapters instead of combining them into one?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 〈61〉 + 〈62〉 = 完整微生物品質評估
blocks.en: Core Concept: <61> + <62> = Complete Microbial Quality Assessment

blocks.zh: USP 微生物品質章節體系：
blocks.en: The USP microbial quality chapter system:

blocks.zh: 〈61〉 和 〈62〉 是強制性章節（編號 <1000），〈1111〉–〈1113〉 是參考性章節（提供指導但非強制）。
blocks.en: <61> and <62> are mandatory chapters (numbered below 1000), while <1111>-<1113> are informational chapters (they provide guidance but are not mandatory).

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 標準取樣量為 10 g 或 10 mL，特殊情況（低含量 API、極小批量、臨床試驗）有明確的減量規則
blocks.en: The standard sample quantity is 10 g or 10 mL, with clear reduction rules for special cases (low-content API, very small batches, clinical trials)

blocks.zh: 實際產品檢驗培養條件：TAMC 用 SCDA 在 30–35°C 培養 3–5 天；TYMC 用 SDA 在 20–25°C 培養 5–7 天
blocks.en: Incubation conditions for actual product testing: TAMC uses SCDA at 30-35°C for 3-5 days; TYMC uses SDA at 20-25°C for 5-7 days

blocks.zh: 平板計數法菌落上限：TAMC <250 cfu/plate，TYMC <50 cfu/plate
blocks.en: Colony count limits for the plate-count method: TAMC <250 cfu/plate, TYMC <50 cfu/plate

blocks.zh: TAMC = SCDA 上所有 cfu（含黴菌）；TYMC = SDA 上所有 cfu（含細菌）
blocks.en: TAMC = all cfu on SCDA (including molds); TYMC = all cfu on SDA (including bacteria)

blocks.zh: 接受標準判讀：10n cfu 的規格實際最大可接受 2×10n（0.3 log 容差）
blocks.en: Interpreting acceptance criteria: a specification of 10n cfu actually allows a maximum of 2×10n (0.3 log tolerance)

blocks.zh: 〈61〉 + 〈62〉 = 完整評估：計數（多少）+ 鑑別（有沒有致病菌）缺一不可
blocks.en: <61> + <62> = complete assessment: enumeration (how many) and identification (are pathogens present) are both indispensable

blocks.zh: CDMO 商業意義：影響原料放行、製程監控、批次放行決策，且趨勢分析比單次結果更重要
blocks.en: CDMO business significance: It affects raw material release, process monitoring, and batch release decisions, and trend analysis matters more than any single result
